subject: CLAIM c6t-rca-opus #5: GPU-fault recovery (nord2_metal_bridge.c/.h, nord2_transport.inc ops.lost hook, nord2_metal_bridge_test.c)
body: Job fault with clean context MMU state -> bridge reports FAILED to the waiting command and continues (no broken). MMU fault / call error / unreaped work -> bridge lost (as today) + new optional n2mb_ops.lost hook; transport hook logs TEGU_DEVICE_LOST and exits the process so launchd respawns it on a fresh kernel context (ansuz CA-METAL watchdog model; opt-out env NORD2_METAL_LOST=stay). Not touching render_pipeline.inc/air_bridge.rs/compute_frontend.m.
